newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's KFA buys 52,000 tonnes of corn.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's KFA buys 52,000 tonnes of corn.

text.p: The Korea Feed Association's (KFA) members in the southeastern city of Pusan bought late on Thursday 52,000 tonnes of corn at $125.30 a tonne C&F, traders said on Friday.
The purchase was made from Cargill through private negotiations.
They said arrival was set for October 15 to Pusan.
Shipment was set for August 22-September 10 if from the U.S. Gulf and for September 11-30 if from the Pacific Northwest.
The seller can also deliver Chinese corn at $121.30 a tonne, C&F, they said.
